abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 5. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 43 | 250 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 37 | 250 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 61 | 250 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 40 | 250 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
